## v1.9 — BlockESP Block Manager

### New Features
- **BlockESP GUI** — click `[BlockESP]` in the ClickGUI footer to open a two-pane block manager:
  - **Left pane**: shows all currently tracked blocks; click any row (or the red ×) to remove it
  - **Right pane**: search all registered blocks by name, click to add or remove; a green ✔ marks already-tracked blocks
- **Crosshair keybind** — press **B** (default, rebindable) while looking at any block in the world to instantly add or remove it from the tracking list; an action bar message confirms the change
- **Persistent custom blocks** — your added/removed blocks are saved to `config/claudemc/blockesp.json` and survive restarts
- **Rebindable add-key** — open **Keybinds** screen to change the "BlockESP: Add block" key from the default B to anything you like

### Changes
- All default targets (shulkers, chests, spawners, etc.) remain unchanged; you can remove them via the GUI and they will be remembered
